actual.titulo: PGA Tour Golf • The RSM Classic, First Round
actual.descripcion: The RSM Classic, First Round | Round 1 of The RSM Classic begins at Sea Island Golf Club on St. Simons Island. Golfers tee off across the Seaside and Plantation courses in Georgia, where Finland's Sami Valimaki captured the 2025 title with a winning score of 23-under par.

lista.titulo: PGA Tour Golf • The RSM Classic, Second Round
lista.descripcion: The RSM Classic, Second Round | Round two of The RSM Classic continues at Sea Island Golf Club as players vie to make the cut. Golfers navigate the Tom Fazio-redesigned Seaside Course, a 7,157-yard, par-70 layout built in 1929 on St. Simons Island featuring bermudagrass greens.
